li.label: a head cold
li.description: My nose won't stop running.

li.label: stuffed up with a cold
li.description: I can't breathe through my nose, and my head feels full of wool.

li.label: a miserable cold
li.description: Everything aches and I can't stop sneezing. I want my bed.

li.label: queasy
li.description: My stomach is turning over. I don't trust it.

li.label: a stomach bug
li.description: I've been sick twice since breakfast. I'm not eating anything else today.

li.label: a bad stomach bug
li.description: I've spent half the day bent over a bucket. I just want it to stop.

li.label: a tickly cough
li.description: There's a tickle in my chest that won't leave me alone.

li.label: a chesty cough
li.description: Every cough comes from somewhere deep down. It keeps me up at night.

li.label: a hacking cough
li.description: I can't finish a sentence without coughing. My ribs hurt from it.

li.label: hay fever
li.description: Sneezing again. It's the flowers.

li.label: bad hay fever
li.description: My eyes are streaming and my nose is raw. I can barely see what I'm doing.

li.label: itchy eyes
li.description: My eyes itch, and I'm not supposed to rub them.

li.label: pinkeye
li.description: My eyes are red and weeping. I woke up with them stuck shut.

li.label: restless nights
li.description: I keep waking up in the night, and I can't settle again.

li.label: dreamfever
li.description: The dreams are so real. This morning I went looking for a door that isn't there.

li.label: waking dreams
li.description: I'm not always sure which things are dreams. The walls moved again today.

li.label: a stiff back
li.description: My back's stiff. I felt it go on the last load.

li.label: a sore back
li.description: Bending over hurts. Getting up hurts more.

li.label: my back's gone
li.description: I can barely stand up straight. Every step goes through my back.

li.label: aching hands
li.description: My hands ache from all that work. I can feel every joint.

li.label: swollen wrists
li.description: My wrists are swollen. I dropped a cup this morning.

li.label: sore feet
li.description: My feet are sore from walking.

li.label: broken blisters
li.description: The blisters have burst. Every step stings.

li.label: itchy fingers
li.description: My fingers itch where the cold got them.

li.label: chilblains
li.description: My toes are red and swollen, and they itch so much I could scream.

li.label: a touch of sunburn
li.description: My neck's gone pink from the sun.

li.label: sunburned
li.description: My skin is burning. I can't stand anything touching my shoulders.

li.label: a scratchy throat
li.description: The smoke has left my throat raw.

li.label: a smoke cough
li.description: I can still taste the smoke. I keep coughing up gray.

li.label: a twinging tooth
li.description: One of my teeth twinges whenever I chew.

li.label: a throbbing toothache
li.description: My tooth throbs with my heartbeat. I can't think about anything else.

li.label: a stiff neck
li.description: I can't turn my head without wincing. I slept wrong.

li.label: a twisted ankle
li.description: I turned my ankle. I'm limping, but it holds.

li.label: a sprained ankle
li.description: My ankle's swollen up like a melon. I can't put weight on it.

li.label: tired eyes
li.description: My eyes ache and my head hurts. Too long squinting at close work.

li.label: a damp cough
li.description: There's a wet cough in my chest that smells like the room I sleep in.

li.label: rimrot cough
li.description: My chest rattles when I breathe. It's that damp room.

li.label: a sooty cough
li.description: I keep coughing up soot.

li.label: ash lung
li.description: My chest is tight and my phlegm is gray. I can't get a full breath.

li.label: a cough that won't quit
li.description: I'm better, but this cough is hanging on.

li.label: getting my strength back
li.description: I'm over the worst. I just tire so quickly.

li.label: still weak
li.description: I'm up again, but my legs shake after a few steps.

li.label: lockjaw
li.description: My jaw won't open properly. I know what that means.

li.label: rigid muscles
li.description: My whole body is clenched like a fist, and I can't make it let go.

li.label: tetanus spasms
li.description: The spasms come out of nowhere. I'm afraid of the next one.

li.label: severe tetanus
li.description: Every spasm takes my breath away. I'm afraid I won't get it back.

li.label: pneumonia coming on
li.description: I'm hot, then cold, and it hurts to breathe in.

li.label: pneumonia
li.description: The fever's high and every breath hurts. I'm scared.

li.label: struggling to breathe
li.description: I can't get enough air. I'm so tired.

li.label: the pneumonia crisis
li.description: I can't breathe. I don't know if I'll see tomorrow.

li.label: a cough that won't go
li.description: This cough has been with me for weeks. I've stopped pretending it's nothing.

li.label: consumption
li.description: I'm wasting away. I eat and eat and the weight still falls off me.

li.label: wasting
li.description: I can hardly climb out of bed. My clothes hang off me.

li.label: dying of consumption
li.description: I don't think I have much time left.

li.label: typhus fever
li.description: My head is pounding and I'm burning up.

li.label: typhus rash
li.description: There's a rash spreading over my chest, and the fever won't break.

li.label: typhus stupor
li.description: Everything is far away and foggy.

li.label: typhus delirium
li.description: They keep talking to me, but I can't make sense of the words.

li.label: a crushing headache
li.description: My head is splitting and the light hurts my eyes.

li.label: meningitis
li.description: My neck won't bend and the headache is the worst pain I've known.

li.label: confused
li.description: I don't know where I am. Who are these people?

li.label: seizures
li.description: My body keeps seizing up. I'm terrified.

li.label: tired all the time
li.description: I'm so tired, and I don't know why. I sleep and wake up tired.

li.label: sore gums
li.description: My gums are sore and my knees ache. Something's wrong with the food.

li.label: bleeding gums
li.description: My gums bleed when I eat, and bruises come up from nothing.

li.label: advanced scurvy
li.description: My old scars are aching. I'm falling apart.

li.label: glittering fever
li.description: There's a glitter under my skin, and I'm burning up.

li.label: stiffening joints
li.description: My joints are stiffening. They click like glass.

li.label: glass joints
li.description: I can barely bend my fingers. I'm turning to glass.

li.label: crystallizing
li.description: My chest feels like it's full of broken glass.

li.label: restless nights
li.description: I lie awake for hours and get up more tired than I went to bed.

li.label: can't sleep
li.description: Another night staring at the ceiling. My eyes feel full of sand.

li.label: a headache coming on
li.description: There's an ache behind one eye, and the light is starting to bother me.

li.label: a migraine
li.description: My head is splitting and every sound is too loud. I need a dark room.

li.label: heartburn
li.description: That meal is sitting in my chest like a hot coal.

li.label: a nosebleed
li.description: My nose started bleeding out in the cold. It looked worse than it felt.

li.label: queasy from the road
li.description: The swaying never stops, and my stomach doesn't like it.

li.label: travel-sick
li.description: I've been sick twice today. I'd give anything for ground that keeps still.

li.label: a splinter
li.description: There's a splinter deep in my palm. I feel it every time I grip something.

li.label: itchy bites
li.description: The bugs got me. Every bite itches.

li.label: eaten alive
li.description: I'm covered in bites and I can't stop scratching. I barely slept.

li.label: an itchy rash
li.description: Some plant in the field has given me a rash. It itches like mad.

li.label: blistered arms
li.description: My arms are covered in blisters from that plant. I want to tear my skin off.

li.label: frostnip
li.description: My fingertips went white and numb out there. Now they sting.

li.label: prickly heat
li.description: I'm covered in tiny itchy bumps from the heat, and everything sticks to me.

li.label: a cold sore
li.description: I've got a cold sore on my lip. I keep touching it, and I know I shouldn't.

li.label: an itchy scalp
li.description: My head itches all the time. I think I've caught lice.

li.label: lice
li.description: I can feel them crawling at night. I want to boil everything I own.

li.label: itchy toes
li.description: Between my toes itches and stings. It's all the wading.

li.label: cracked feet
li.description: My feet are cracked and peeling, and every step stings.

li.label: hiccups
li.description: I can't stop hiccuping, and people keep trying to make me jump.

li.label: nerve pain
li.description: The shingles rash is gone, but the burning under the skin isn't.

li.label: cholera
li.description: I can't keep anything in. I'm so thirsty, and it runs straight through me.

li.label: dried out
li.description: My mouth is dry as dust and the room spins when I sit up.

li.label: badly dried out
li.description: I can't lift my arms. Someone keeps holding a cup to my lips.

li.label: collapsing
li.description: Everything is cold and far away.

li.label: a belly ache
li.description: There's a pain low in my belly that won't settle.

li.label: appendicitis
li.description: The pain has moved to my right side and it's sharp now. I can't stand up straight.

li.label: something burst
li.description: Something gave way inside me. Now the pain is everywhere.

li.label: peritonitis
li.description: My belly is hard as a board and burning. I'm frightened.

li.label: a bite that might be rabid
li.description: The animal that bit me wasn't right. I keep looking at the bite.

li.label: rabies fever
li.description: The bite is tingling and I'm burning up. I know what that means.

li.label: terror of water
li.description: They brought me water and I couldn't bear to look at it.

li.label: paralyzed
li.description: I can't feel my legs anymore.

li.label: feverish
li.description: I'm hot and my eyes hurt and I keep coughing.

li.label: measles
li.description: I'm covered in spots and I have to stay in bed.

li.label: very sick with measles
li.description: I feel really bad. I want someone to sit with me.

li.label: an aching side
li.description: There's still a dull ache in my side, but the worst is over.

li.label: passing a stone
li.description: The pain comes in waves. When it comes, I can't think about anything else.

li.label: renal colic
li.description: It's the worst pain I've ever had. I can't sit, I can't lie down.

li.label: healing shingles
li.description: The blisters are drying up. It still burns a little.

li.label: shingles
li.description: There's a band of blisters round my ribs, and even my shirt hurts.

li.label: burning shingles
li.description: It burns as if someone were holding a torch to my side.

li.label: a swollen sting
li.description: The insect wound has gone hot and hard.

li.label: hive fever
li.description: I'm burning up, and the wound throbs with my heartbeat.

li.label: the hum
li.description: There's a hum in my ears that won't stop. It sounds like the hive.

li.label: hive convulsions
li.description: My body won't stop shaking, and I can still hear them.

li.label: a hard case
li.description: One of ours is seriously ill, and it's on me to pull them through.

li.label: pulled a patient through
li.description: I nursed someone through a bad illness, and they lived.

li.label: over the worst
li.description: I was really sick, and I came through it. Breakfast tasted better this morning.
